description: Find Chapter 99 candidate headings and source references for an exact eight- or ten-digit commodity number. Coverage is partial and empty candidates never establish clearance. Use candidates, evidence with a returned candidateCode, or unmapped views; follow returned noteId and noteCursor for complete source passages. Country comparisons retain unknown and different-country evidence. No applicability, current legal status, exclusions, stacking or combined duties are determined.

candidateCode.description: Returned Chapter 99 candidate number, only with view evidence.

code.description: Exact eight- or ten-digit base commodity number, bare or conventionally dotted; Chapter 99 input is invalid.

countryCode.description: Assigned ISO alpha-2 country; comparison only, never sent upstream.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool with identical arguments.

limit.description: Requested items as a positive safe integer; effectiveLimit discloses clamping to at most 100, and pages may be byte limited. Keep the same requested limit for continuation.

noteCursor.description: Returned nextNoteCursor; requires the same noteId and original selectors.

noteId.description: Returned supporting passage identifier; cannot combine with candidateCode, cursor or a nondefault view.

view.description: One result collection; evidence requires candidateCode.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_code`: Identifier is not an exact eight- or ten-digit base commodity number. `invalid_country`: Country is not an assigned ISO alpha-2 value. `invalid_selector`: Evidence, passage and collection selectors cannot be combined as requested. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is malformed or bound to different arguments. `cursor_expired`: Index or base snapshot expired, was evicted, or changed edition. `release_changed`: Edition changes twice during complete source assembly. `invalid_hierarchy`: Complete base heading cannot establish safe ancestry. `notes_structure_changed`: Required Chapter 99 structure is missing or cannot be decoded. `note_not_found`: Passage does not belong to this commodity query, source digest or edition. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
